mapper.sql: P.SEQ as seq, P.SURVEY_USER_SEQ as surveyUserSeq, P.EVENT_SEQ as eventSeq, P.CHECK_CODE as checkCode, P.DEPARTMENT as department, P.POSITION as position, P.PARTICIPANT_TYPE as participantType, P.MEMO as memo, P.NAMETAG_PRINTED as nametagPrinted, P.REG_DATE as regDate, P.MOD_DATE as modDate
, U.USER_NAME as userName, U.USER_PHONE as userPhone, U.USER_EMAIL as userEmail
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM EVENT_PARTICIPANT P INNER JOIN SURVEY_USER U ON P.SURVEY_USER_SEQ = U.SEQ WHERE P.EVENT_SEQ = #{eventSeq} AND U.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY P.REG_DATE DESC

SELECT
FROM EVENT_PARTICIPANT P INNER JOIN SURVEY_USER U ON P.SURVEY_USER_SEQ = U.SEQ WHERE P.EVENT_SEQ = #{eventSeq} AND U.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY P.REG_DATE DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EVENT_PARTICIPANT P INNER JOIN SURVEY_USER U ON P.SURVEY_USER_SEQ = U.SEQ WHERE P.EVENT_SEQ = #{eventSeq} AND U.DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO EVENT_PARTICIPANT ( SURVEY_USER_SEQ, EVENT_SEQ, CHECK_CODE, DEPARTMENT, POSITION, PARTICIPANT_TYPE, MEMO, NAMETAG_PRINTED, REG_DATE ) VALUES ( #{surveyUserSeq}, #{eventSeq}, #{checkCode}, #{department}, #{position}, #{participantType}, #{memo}, #{nametagPrinted}, NOW() )

INSERT INTO EVENT_PARTICIPANT ( SURVEY_USER_SEQ, EVENT_SEQ, CHECK_CODE, DEPARTMENT, POSITION, PARTICIPANT_TYPE, MEMO, NAMETAG_PRINTED, REG_DATE ) VALUES
(#{item.surveyUserSeq}, #{item.eventSeq}, #{item.checkCode}, #{item.department}, #{item.position}, #{item.participantType}, #{item.memo}, #{item.nametagPrinted}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE EVENT_PARTICIPANT SET DEPARTMENT = #{department}, POSITION = #{position}, PARTICIPANT_TYPE = #{participantType}, MEMO = #{memo}, MOD_DATE = NOW() WHERE SEQ = #{seq}
UPDATE EVENT_PARTICIPANT SET NAMETAG_PRINTED = #{nametagPrinted}, MOD_DATE = NOW() WHERE SEQ = #{seq}
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM EVENT_PARTICIPANT P INNER JOIN SURVEY_USER U ON P.SURVEY_USER_SEQ = U.SEQ INNER JOIN SURVEY_MASTER M ON P.EVENT_SEQ = M.EVENT_SEQ WHERE P.SEQ = #{seq} AND U.DEL_YN = 'N'

SELECT
FROM EVENT_PARTICIPANT P INNER JOIN SURVEY_USER U ON P.SURVEY_USER_SEQ = U.SEQ INNER JOIN SURVEY_MASTER M ON P.EVENT_SEQ = M.EVENT_SEQ WHERE P.CHECK_CODE = #{checkCode} AND U.DEL_YN = 'N'

SELECT COALESCE(P.PARTICIPANT_TYPE, '미지정') as participantType, COUNT(*) as count, COUNT(CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM EVENT_ACTION_LOG L INNER JOIN EVENT_ACTION_TYPE T ON L.ACTION_TYPE_SEQ = T.SEQ WHERE L.PARTICIPANT_SEQ = P.SEQ AND T.ACTION_CODE = 'CHECK_IN' ) THEN 1 END) as checkedInCount FROM EVENT_PARTICIPANT P INNER JOIN SURVEY_USER U ON P.SURVEY_USER_SEQ = U.SEQ WHERE P.EVENT_SEQ = #{eventSeq} AND U.DEL_YN = 'N' GROUP BY P.PARTICIPANT_TYPE ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) as totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN P.NAMETAG_PRINTED = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as printedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN P.NAMETAG_PRINTED != 'Y' OR P.NAMETAG_PRINTED IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as notPrintedCount FROM EVENT_PARTICIPANT P INNER JOIN SURVEY_USER U ON P.SURVEY_USER_SEQ = U.SEQ WHERE P.EVENT_SEQ = #{eventSeq} AND U.DEL_YN = 'N'

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EVENT_PARTICIPANT P INNER JOIN SURVEY_USER U ON P.SURVEY_USER_SEQ = U.SEQ WHERE P.EVENT_SEQ = #{eventSeq} AND U.DEL_YN = 'N') as totalCount, COUNT(DISTINCT L.PARTICIPANT_SEQ) as checkedInCount FROM EVENT_ACTION_LOG L INNER JOIN EVENT_PARTICIPANT P ON L.PARTICIPANT_SEQ = P.SEQ INNER JOIN EVENT_ACTION_TYPE T ON L.ACTION_TYPE_SEQ = T.SEQ WHERE P.EVENT_SEQ = #{eventSeq} AND T.ACTION_CODE = 'CHECK_IN'

SELECT
FROM EVENT_PARTICIPANT P INNER JOIN SURVEY_USER U ON P.SURVEY_USER_SEQ = U.SEQ INNER JOIN SURVEY_MASTER M ON P.EVENT_SEQ = M.EVENT_SEQ WHERE P.EVENT_SEQ = #{eventSeq} AND U.USER_NAME = #{userName} AND U.DEL_YN = 'N'

SELECT , (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(T2.ACTION_NAME, ':', COALESCE(DATE_FORMAT(L2.ACTION_TIME, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i'), '미완료')) SEPARATOR ' | ') FROM EVENT_ACTION_TYPE T2 LEFT JOIN EVENT_ACTION_LOG L2 ON T2.SEQ = L2.ACTION_TYPE_SEQ AND L2.PARTICIPANT_SEQ = P.SEQ WHERE T2.EVENT_SEQ = P.EVENT_SEQ AND T2.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY T2.SORT_ORDER) as actionSummary FROM EVENT_PARTICIPANT P INNER JOIN SURVEY_USER U ON P.SURVEY_USER_SEQ = U.SEQ INNER JOIN SURVEY_MASTER M ON P.EVENT_SEQ = M.EVENT_SEQ WHERE P.EVENT_SEQ = #{eventSeq} AND U.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY P.REG_DATE ASC
